extracted.CURRENT_POSTURE_AS_OF_2026_07_30: NO Fifth Circuit decision was located. Multiple independent searches for a June or July 2026 ruling returned nothing. The panel appears not to have ruled, four months after argument. THIS IS AN OPEN APPEAL WITH LIVE APA ISSUES.
extracted.WHY_THIS_ARGUES_FOR_EXCLUSION_NOT_INCLUS: An undecided appeal on whether FDA's delisting was procedurally valid means the legal status of compounded GLP-1s could change on any given day with no advance notice. A static price-comparison site cannot track that. Publishing compounded options creates an obligation to be correct about a question a federal appellate panel has had under submission for four months. Exclusion is the only posture that is robust to either outcome.
extracted.enforcement_reality_regardless_of_appeal: Secondary commentary consistently reports that the enforcement posture is settled in FDA's favor at present and that 'essentially a copy' mass compounding of semaglutide or tirzepatide is impermissible under both 503A and 503B today. Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly are separately reported to be filing suit and sending cease-and-desist letters to compounders, clinics and telehealth companies.
